title: Man. Post. Cap. IX: PLAC — distinct persons did not commit Adam's one numerical actual sin (nor one numerical death)
pass_a_gloss: But those distinct persons did not commit Adam's one numerical actual sin. One numerical actual sin of every human person is as impossible as one numerical death of everyone. Tip of the syllogism press.
pass_b_english: But it is already plain that the distinct and separate persons of all men, apart from Adam's person, did not commit that one actual sin, one and the same in number, which Adam committed. And it is as impossible that there should be one numerical actual sin of all the persons of the human race as that there should be one numerical death of all.
source_text: Iam autem manifestum est, omnium hominum personas distinctas & separatas a persona Adami non commisisse peccatum illud actuale unum idemque numero quod Adamus commisit, & tam impossibile esse ut omnium personarum generis humani sit unicum numero peccatum actuale, quam ut sit unica numero mors omnium.

choices.choice: Distinct persons ≠ Adam's one numerical act
